title: The Stark problem in a Debye plasma: a coupled-channel complex-scaling map of field-screening competition

production.hydrogen_limit_check: assembled system checked against -1/(2 n^2), deviation < 1e-10 on the lowest levels, before every production run; a failed check aborts the run

anchors.note: pure-Stark anchors of Table 'anchors' computed on these two independent discretizations; inter-grid drift quoted as truncation-error estimate

notes: Quoted uncertainties are theta_c-spreads and inter-grid drifts, i.e. error estimates calibrated against the benchmarks, not rigorous bounds.
